title: [v3-4-test] Keep the multiselect filter pill's focus ring visible (#75307)
body:
While editing a tags, owners or other multiselect filter, the pill draws
its focus ring as an outline outside its box. The row below the filters
starts right at the pill's edge, so the sticky header of the Dags table
painted over the bottom of the ring.
(cherry picked from commit 469800c11d26570b0d11cdc42ecaf4c97c191ff4)

Co-authored-by: Pierre Jeambrun <pierrejbrun@gmail.com>
